title: # M1 Consolidated Closeout Report v1.1
status_version_lines: Date2026-11-08. **Documentation consolidated; bounded eligible validation attempted; implementation planning prepared. M1 product acceptance/completion is not claimed.** Product implementation and release remain Not Authorized. ADR statuses unchanged.

The [owner instruction](../../evidence/20261108T094414Z-m1-consolidated-closeout/supplied/owner-task-authorization.txt) authorized repository documentation, safe isolated EXP/SVC validation/fixtures/builds/evidence and implementation planning. It did not authorize product features, release/signing-notarization approval/distribution, branch changes, commits or pushes. Started clean on timeline; actual HEAD and tracked hashes are in [baseline](../../evidence/20261108T094414Z-m1-consolidated-closeout/repository-baseline.json). No production app source/configuration or Phase3 source/evidence was changed. Final audit is [here](../../evidence/20261108T094414Z-m1-consolidated-closeout/final-audit.json).

[Source catalog](m1-source-catalog.md) is the authority for actual paths, versions and supersession. [M1 index](README.md) links the canonical set. Exact full supplied DS/VP/SVC/CT/readiness sources were retrieved from the existing chat and archived, not reconstructed from summaries. Prior repository documents were archived before being labelled historical or reconciled.

Version 1.1 — Proposed engineering baseline, 2026-11-08. Supersedes the supplied v1.0 for current policy and validation authority; [exact v1.0 source](../../evidence/20261108T094414Z-m1-consolidated-closeout/supplied/developer-specification-v1.0-proposed.md) is preserved. Final outcomes are in [evidence reports](../../evidence/20261108T094414Z-m1-consolidated-closeout/reports/) and [closeout](m1-closeout-report.md).

ADR0001 Proposed; ADR0002 Accepted; ADR0003–0005 Proposed. WKWebView remains conditionally accepted for MVP planning/implementation; CEF evaluation-only; Aura excluded; no production Tamizhi or mandatory identity/cloud; no public distribution.

title: # M1 Implementation Plan v1.1 — Proposed
status_version_lines: # M1 Implementation Plan v1.1 — Proposed

2026-11-08. **Planning Authorized; product implementation Not Started/Not Authorized; release Not Authorized.** This replaces the prior proposed I0–I7 breakdown as the maintained planning view. [Original plan](../../evidence/20261108T094414Z-m1-consolidated-closeout/supplied/repository-original-m1-implementation-plan.md) remains historical; no earlier implementation proposal is retroactively granted. All19 packages below are backlog tasks, not instructions to execute now.

Readiness is technical readiness for a future finite authorization; even Conditional packages are not authorized to implement. Relative complexity M/L/XL is not a schedule or staffing estimate. Every package inherits: separate implementation authorization, reviewed scope, source-pinned meaningful tests, no cross-profile/private leakage or unauthorized native effects, truthful partial outcomes and independent security review where required.
